entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, yes. I need to... I think I need to return something? I ordered a jersey and it just isn't right.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
It's Anya Sharma. The order number is... uh... VF8871-25. I think.

Got it, Anya. I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey delivered on December 22nd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just... I think I got the wrong size. It's really too tight, and I wanted to do an exchange, but the website was so confusing. I couldn't figure it out. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help with that. I'm sorry to hear the website was giving you trouble. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. It's all just a bit overwhelming.

Alright, Anya, I've pulled up your account. It looks like the jersey was delivered 26 days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. We can absolutely process a return or an exchange for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So I can exchange it for a different size?

Yes, you can. And since you're a VIP member and had some trouble with the website, I'm going to waive the return shipping fee for you and email you a pre-paid label right now. You can use that to send back the jersey that's too tight, and we can get the correct size shipped out.
Wow, that's so much easier. Thank you, Isaac! That's a huge help.

You're very welcome, Anya. I've just sent that email. Just print the label, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives!
